craft_evidence.makers: NONE (Our Story names none; says mills and workshops are mostly small and family-run)
craft_evidence.mills: Partial: product copy names the Wakayama loopwheel knitting factory (69 of 821 products mention Wakayama), Fox Brothers (2), Kojima (4); no mill named as such on Our Story
craft_evidence.madein: low: 7 of 468 apparel pages carry the literal phrase made in Japan; Our Story does not state it
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: Works Inc and Iron Heart established 2002, Shibuya and Hachioji offices
craft_evidence.process: yes: loopwheel on vintage tsuriami-ki machines, unsanforised loomstate denim, sulphur dyeing, in-house chain-stitch hemming (Hamburg)
craft_evidence.reasoning: Names regions and some mills (Wakayama loopwheel, Himeji leather, Fox Brothers) and documents process, but states no owned factory and no named sewing maker; made-in country is on a small share of pages. Medium confidence; one-step swing to 4 if Works Inc is shown to own a factory.

ownership.owner: Business solely owned by Alex, son of Giles Padmore (brand wording; surname not given). International arm run from Gosport UK since 2005

opview: “Iron Heart was originally made for bikers, and even today that focus guides design and construction of the clothing.” — Iron Heart (house), Our Story
